adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms flapping at sides or outstretched with rolling motion/bent elbows.
movement_profile.footwork: Weight shifting from foot to foot, transitioning to tiptoes.
movement_profile.partnering: Male dancer cues the group for position changes.

signature_moves.description: Arms outstretched and flapping to imitate the departure of an eagle.
signature_moves.name: Eagle Flight

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Interlocking parts starting with the gandang, followed by the sompogogungan.
music_profile.sound_description: A steady, interlocking percussive sound dominated by the deep resonance of hanging gongs and the rhythmic beat of a double-headed drum.

basic_steps: Shift weight from foot to foot with knees bent.
Swing arms at sides in time to the music.
Extend arms outward with rolling or downward-bent elbow motion.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly, focus on rhythmic weight shifting and arm posture.
teaching.rhythm: Interlocking rhythmic pattern of gongs and drums.
